narrative:
Cost to serve is GBP 1,330.0M in the FY2026 budget — 72.5% of revenue. The delivery workforce is 62% of it, subcontractors and clinical assessors 14%, delivery technology and case management 9%, telephony and contact platforms 7%, delivery sites 5% and KPI service credits 3%.

The pressure is in Pension Solutions: about 380 surge FTE are working the Civil Service Pension Scheme backlog against 260 planned. Wage inflation is running at 4.1% against 3.5% in the plan, and only 62% is recovered through indexation.

Lower contact volumes and virtual-agent containment offset part of it — the Q3 forecast cost to serve is 1.1% below budget.

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.

signals.title: Delivery wage inflation only partly recovered
signals.excerpt: About £6M of the April 2026 National Living Wage and employer NICs increase is unrecovered; 62% passes through indexation clauses.
